decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for a marquee to be erected in the grounds of Osterley House, because of the position, design and appearance of the  Marquee, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of  this Listed building and historic garden and would not be detrimental to the  appearance of the Listed building 
or to the character of the Osterley Park Conservation  Area.  The development is in accordance with the UDP Policies  ENV- B.1.1 (New  Development), ENVB2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENVB 1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), ENVB 2.5  (Development affecting the setting of a Listed Building),  ENVB 2.8 (Views and 
Landmarks), ENVN 1.9  (Metropolitan Open Land Improvements), ENVN 1.5 (Protection of MOL), ENVN 1.6 (Metropolitan Open Land Acceptable Uses) ENVN 1.15 (Heritage Land), ENVN 1.16 (Historic  Parks and Gardens), ENVN 2.2 (Sites of regional/ Local Nature 
Conservation), T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for  Developments) and Supplementary Planning Guidance, Osterley Park Conservation Area.
Condition : 2 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on 31/10/09 when the use shall cease.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the marquee shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
Condition : 6 - In the Autumn of each year, for the duration of this permission, the marquee shall be dismantled and the land  restored to its former condition.
Condition : 7 - No excavations shall take place without an archaeological evaluation.

Condition : 8 - A landscape restoration schedule of works consistent with the draft National Trust Historic Park Restoration Plan (of April 2005) shall be submitted to and approved by the LPA prior to the occupation of the marquee during the first season of its use.   This schedule of works shall provide a detailed list of physical works undertaken to the Great Meadow and the Pleasure Grounds and planting to the park perimeter.   Restoration works shall be carried out in accordance with the appropriate schedule.
Condition : 9 - That the car parking area as shown on the plan submitted on 1 March 2006 shall be exclusively used for function parking associated with the marquee use when operational.

Condition : 10 - The application hereby approved shall not commence until after 6pm Monday to Friday and 2.30pm on Saturdays.  The use shall cease no later than 11.30pm Monday to Saturday.  No use shall take place on a Saturday before 6pm.
description: Erection of a 6.25 m high marquee for use as events marquee on a seasonal basis for 3 years, in grounds of Osterley Park
